# ViraStack Mask

> Lightweight, type-safe input masking for React Hook Form: cards, phone, IBAN, currency, TCKN, and custom patterns via `useViraMask()`.

Install with `npm install @virastack/mask`. Peers: `react`, `react-dom`, `react-hook-form`. Form state keeps raw (unmasked) values; inputs show formatted display values.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/mask/docs): Install, peers, and scope.
- [useViraMask()](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/use-vira-mask): Hook API, schema, return fields, RHF sync.
- [Custom mask](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/custom-mask): Pattern syntax (`9` / `a` / `*`), MaskOptions, `resolveMask`.
- [Validation](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/validation): Built-in validators and custom error messages.
- [Helpers](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/helpers): `applyMask`, currency helpers, `getCardType`, `mergeRefs`.
- [Types](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/types): `MaskPreset`, `MaskOptions`, schema types.
- [UI libraries](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/ui-libraries): shadcn, Ant Design, Chakra; same prop-spread pattern.
- [Examples](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples): Live presets (card, phone, IBAN, currency, and more).

## Notable examples

- [Credit card form](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/credit-card): Card + expiry + CVV (Amex-aware).
- [Card](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/card): BIN detection (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Troy).
- [Phone](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/phone): TR phone mask.
- [IBAN](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/iban): TR IBAN with mod-97 validation.
- [TCKN](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/tckn): Turkish national ID.
- [Currency](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/examples/currency): Locale-aware money formatting.
